import json, os, sys

args=sys.argv[1:]
probe=any(a in args for a in ('-v','--version','-dumpversion','-dumpmachine'))
link=not probe and not any(a in args for a in ('-c','-E','-S'))
program=link and any(a.startswith('@') and a.endswith(('/link-cc.rsp','/link-cxx.rsp')) for a in args)
extra=['/home/arobin/Work/Projects/goose-libs/libraries/goose-artifact/.build/bench-gcc-54bd061b5086d29a/transport.o', '-Wl,--wrap=curl_multi_add_handle', '-lcurl'] if program else []
effective=[compiler,*args,*([] if probe else flags),*extra]
with open(log,'a') as f: f.write(json.dumps(effective)+'\n')
os.execv(compiler,effective)

machine.pinning: none; the measured process inherits the parent affinity mask

fixture_shim.scope: wraps curl_multi_add_handle only to set CURLOPT_CAINFO for the expected loopback URL; no fault-injection wrappers are linked

control_kinds.digest-control: metadata signs an all-zero digest; the body is still fully transferred, hashed and written before DigestMismatch
control_kinds.startup-floor: the signature is over different bytes, so the run is rejected at Signature before any network or file mutation; this measures the process startup floor

fixture.order_policy: round-robin across sizes to spread drift; no A/B comparison is made, so no alternating implementation order applies
fixture.server: owned ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1 with an ephemeral self-signed CA

observations.work_proof: every digest-control sample reports received_bytes == written_bytes == size before failing at DigestMismatch, and every startup-floor sample reports zero transferred bytes; the timed path therefore performs the real transfer, hash and write rather than folding to an idle path

limitations: One host, one toolchain, one bounded fixture set; no universal performance claim
No Rust or other implementation is compared; no improvement ratio is claimed
The measured binary links a fixture shim that sets CURLOPT_CAINFO for the loopback CA; it is not byte-identical to the production binary and its cost is inside every sample
Loopback TLS and a local filesystem do not represent a wide-area network or a real disk
No CPU pinning: scheduler migration and frequency scaling are inside every sample
peak_rss_kib_sampled is a polled VmHWM observation, a lower bound on true peak, not a hard memory promise
elapsed_ns is end-to-end process wall time; per-phase costs are not separated
At these small sizes the sample is dominated by process startup and the TLS handshake, so no library throughput is isolated and no bytes-per-second figure is claimed
CI runs a correctness smoke only; no timing threshold is asserted anywhere
